timetable.title: Timetable
timetable.subtitle: The weekly timetable for {{year}}: generate a draft from the teacher allocations, adjust it, publish it.
timetable.subtitleNoYear: Set up an academic year first (Academic setup › Years).
timetable.empty: No timetable has been published yet.
timetable.emptyEdit: No timetable yet. Start a draft, then generate it from the teacher allocations (Academic setup › Teacher allocation — set the periods per week there).
timetable.draftEmptyHint: This draft is empty. Generate it to fill the week from the teacher allocations, or set cells by hand.

generateConfirm.title: Generate the week again?
generateConfirm.message: Every cell that isn’t locked is replaced. Locked cells stay where they are.

publishConfirm.title: Publish version {{v}}?
publishConfirm.message: Teachers and families see this timetable from today, and substitutions are planned from it. The timetable published before is kept as an old version.

timetable.editHint: Click a cell to change it. A cell you set by hand is locked and kept the next time the week is generated.
timetable.pickSomething: Pick a class, teacher or room to see its week.
timetable.lockedAll: Every cell of this class is locked.

unplaced.hint: Usually a teacher has more periods than the week allows, or a practical has no free lab. Lower the periods per week, add a lab, relax the rules, or place these by hand.

cell.title: {{day}}, period {{period}}
cell.subject: Subject
cell.lockHint: A locked cell stays where it is when the week is generated again.

rules.title: Timetable rules
rules.maxSame: Most periods of a subject in a day
rules.maxSameHint: Usually 2 — a double period for practicals.
rules.teacherMax: Most periods a teacher takes in a day
rules.teacherMaxHint: The generator never gives a teacher more than this.
rules.blockedHint: A part-time teacher, a coordinator’s meeting — the generator leaves these periods free for them.

load.title: Teacher load
load.subtitle: Periods in this timetable against the periods per week in their allocations.

mine.none: No timetable has been published yet.

subs.title: Substitutions
subs.subtitle: Cover an absent teacher’s periods with a free teacher — the ones who teach the class or the subject first.
subs.onLeave: On leave that day (from Staff & HR): {{names}}
subs.noPeriods: They have no periods on that day.

rooms.title: Rooms & bell schedules
rooms.subtitle: The classrooms and labs the timetable uses, and the day’s periods and breaks.
rooms.name: Name
rooms.homeOfHint: The class sits here unless a period needs a lab.
rooms.deleteHint: A room already used in a timetable is switched off instead.
rooms.deactivated: Room used in a timetable — switched off instead.
rooms.noLabsHint: Add your science and computer labs: practical subjects are placed in a free lab, never two classes in one lab at a time.

bells.name: Name
bells.label: Label
bells.isDefault: The default — every class not on another schedule follows it
bells.classesHint: A class follows one schedule; picking it here takes it off any other.
bells.forOthers: Every class not on another schedule
bells.deleteConfirm: Delete {{name}}? Its classes go back to the default schedule.
